newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eleven pct of French households poor -INSEE.
newsitem.headline: Eleven pct of French households poor -INSEE.

text.p: Some 11 percent of French households live below the poverty line, a figure just under the European Union average of 11.8 percent, a study by national statistics institute released on Wednesday showed.
The poverty threshold is fixed at 3,199 francs per month.
Some 7.3 percent of French children live in poverty, INSEE said in the study.

The poor in France are most likely to be found among the aging and rural poulation and are, for the most part, people living alone, although there are many large families which fall into the poverty category, INSEE said.
